name: near-agencies#94 at 34e6db3: volunteer tasks
head: 34e6db3f6defca145671c2e756982d66ffae7ad4
source: Both bugs were found by Claude's review of this commit and fixed in c88cdd7 and 763b565.

bugs.closeIfPaid: Does this code review CLAIM, as a defect, that closeIfPaid (lib/payouts.mjs) can close a job as complete when its volunteer tasks have not been delivered (no delivery/handoff check for volunteers), for example through payout.mjs reconcile or the coordinator path without a proposer? Saying closeIfPaid is correct, or only describing it, is NO.
bugs.recordApprovals: Does this code review CLAIM, as a defect, that in the coordinator sweep the gate job.members.some(m => !m.payout) stays true because volunteer members never get a payout record, so a payout hold (or the continue after it) skips recordApprovals and paid tasks are never recorded as paid? Discussing that gate and concluding it is fine is NO.
